metadata.description: Two plugins from one repo: shipkit, the project knowledge layer (project maps, elder agents, cross-project registry, spec-driven development, composable stack overlays, a session hook that injects the always-on rules); and shipkit-workflows, the opinionated engineering workflows. Install either or both.

plugins.name: shipkit
plugins.description: 10 skills, 3 agents, 9 rules (3 always-on, injected by the session hook; all 9 installed as files by /shipkit:setup's deterministic install scripts, which is what makes the 6 path-scoped ones load; the hook nudges when installed copies are older than the plugin). 10 composable stack overlays (one base + add-ons: Rails+Hotwire+React, Phoenix+LiveView+Oban, Python+ML). Spec-driven development via /shipkit:spec and /shipkit:decide; one-command episodic memory via /shipkit:setup memory. /shipkit:setup remove reverts.

plugins.name: shipkit-workflows
plugins.description: 7 skills, 1 agent. Atomic commits whose message scales to the change, QA, strict TDD, root-cause debugging, legacy audits, migration plans, prose humanizing. Optional companion to the shipkit knowledge layer; each works without the other.
